capabilities: Browse all documents on a paperless-ngx instance from within Obsidian
Insert one or many document references into a note without storing PDF binaries
Replace a Paperless URL in a note with a document reference
Recreate missing PDF++ dummy files referenced by a note
Refresh the cached document, tag, and metadata lists
disambiguation: Not a document-scanning or paperless-workflow tool; it links notes to documents already managed on a paperless-ngx server.
extras: PDF binary data is never downloaded; inserted files are small PDF++ dummy files containing only the Paperless share URL, so documents require an accessible paperless-ngx instance to view.
problem: Obsidian stores PDFs as vault files, so referencing documents from an external document-management system means copying binaries into the vault and growing its size.

relations.evidence: You must also have the ✨amazing✨ PDF++ plugin installed!

summary: Integration that inserts links to PDFs stored on a self-hosted paperless-ngx server, loading documents remotely instead of storing them in the vault.
